title: Concatenating two nonempty strings cannot produce a falsey string

ground_truth.statement: Each operand contains at least one byte, so concatenation has at least two bytes. Neither falsey PHP string, '' or '0', has that length; the non-falsy-string return is sound.

provenance.derivation: Upstream repeats the s1 annotation for s2. Real parameter contracts remove that typo and make the invariant general.

notes: The numeric-string variant shares this criterion; neither uses inferred-type assertions as the oracle. PHPStan and Psalm accept the return. Mago reports invalid-return-statement on line 9, a genuine FP because a concatenation of length at least two cannot be falsey.
